Those numbers are already the latitude and longitude you asked about – they point to the Googleplex in Mountain View, California (≈ 37° 25′ 19.5″ N, 122° 5′ 7.2″ W). If you want to verify or look up an address for those coordinates with the Google Geocoding API, you would make a reverse‑geocode request like this:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

The JSON response will include the formatted address (“1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA …”) and the same latitude/longitude pair in the `location` field. If you’re just looking for the numeric values, they are exactly what you supplied: **37.4224764** (latitude) and **-122.0842499** (longitude).
